title: Cross-platform release artifact acceptance
objective: Verify every final release archive against exact source/build receipts, complete third-party license provenance, binary compatibility, relocation, mathematics, and platform signing policy before publication

oracles: Synthetic tamper corpus and real platform release candidates

handoff.summary: Added fail-closed final-host acceptance for all four release targets plus a complete digest-bound third-party source/license inventory, Node 26.7 builder authority, production npm notice corpus, safe archive preflight, native ABI checks, relocation and mathematics smoke, exact Apple publisher/package/benchmark binding, and explicit unsigned-Windows evidence.
risks: The final platform candidates still need to exercise target-only codesign, pkgutil, Gatekeeper, PE, Mach-O, and runtime checks after workflow integration.
The deliberately strict ZIP policy rejects streaming, ZIP64, non-ASCII paths, links, and ambiguous Unicode-path extras; release assemblers must use the reviewed simple archive layout.
next_steps: Wire this gate into each platform build/signing job before artifact transport or publication.
Make every archive ship both SEA build manifests, the complete licenses directory, and internal SHA256SUMS.
Pass the signed macOS PKG and benchmark sidecars into acceptance and retain each canonical acceptance receipt as a release asset.
